issue.S: The internal ByteGeist status site is unreachable. The bytegeist-web systemd service on app-lin-04 fails immediately after start. Nothing was intentionally changed today, but the service refuses to stay up.

objective.S: Investigate the service, its recent journal output, and the configuration file it depends on. Identify why the service cannot read its configuration and recommend a fix that restores it without weakening file security.

systemctl status bytegeist-web.S:

     Loaded: loaded (/etc/systemd/system/bytegeist-web.service; enabled; preset: enabled)
     Active: failed (Result: exit-code) since Tue 2026-09-22 09:14:52 UTC; 3min ago
   Duration: 412ms
    Process: 18422 ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/bytegeist-web --config /etc/bytegeist/config.yaml (code=exited, status=1/FAILURE)

systemctl cat bytegeist-web.S:
# /etc/systemd/system/bytegeist-web.service
[Unit]
Description=ByteGeist internal status site
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=bytegeist
Group=bytegeist
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/bytegeist-web --config /etc/bytegeist/config.yaml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

expectedDiagnosis.S: The bytegeist-web service runs as the bytegeist user, but /etc/bytegeist/config.yaml is owned by root with mode 0600, so only root can read it. The service fails at startup with Permission denied on the config file, which is why systemctl reports exit code 1 immediately after start.

expectedSolution.S: Give the bytegeist service account read access to the config without opening it to the world. Change group ownership to bytegeist and set mode 0640 (for example, chown root:bytegeist /etc/bytegeist/config.yaml && chmod 0640 /etc/bytegeist/config.yaml), then restart the service with systemctl restart bytegeist-web.
